export const metadata = {
  title: "WheelMates Friends Pass Setup Guide",
  description: "Learn how to set up and play WheelMates for free using the Friend's Pass. Follow our step-by-step host and guest invite guide to start your co-op drive.",
  category: "multiplayer",
  date: "2026-09-03",
}

WheelMates is a two-player cooperative driving adventure developed by The Firevolt Team [1]. In this game, players control RC cars to explore Professor Bloom's home laboratory, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden paths [1]. To make playing with a partner easier, the game features a Friend's Pass system [1]. This system allows one player who owns the full game to invite a friend to play the entire co-op campaign for free [1].

Setting up the WheelMates Friend's Pass is a straightforward process that requires the host to generate an invite code and the guest to enter it in their free version of the game [1]. Both players must also ensure their game versions match to avoid connection issues [1].

## Downloading the Friend's Pass

To begin, only one player needs to purchase and install the full version of WheelMates [1]. The second player does not need to buy the game [1]. Instead, they must download the free WheelMates Friend's Pass [1].

The Friend's Pass can be found on the game's official Steam store page [1]. It was previously available as the game's demo, but it now serves as the dedicated client for joining a host's session [1]. The guest player should search for WheelMates on Steam, locate the Friend's Pass listing, and follow the prompts to download and install it on their computer [1].

## Step-by-Step Setup Guide

Once both players have installed their respective versions of the game, follow these steps to connect and start playing:

### For the Host (Game Owner)
1. Launch the full version of WheelMates [1].
2. From the main menu, click **Play** [1].
3. Select **Play Online** and then click **Host** to create a lobby [1].
4. Look at the bottom-right corner of the screen to find the unique **Invite Code** [1].
5. Copy this code and share it directly with your friend [1].

### For the Guest (Friend's Pass User)
1. Launch the WheelMates Friend's Pass version [1].
2. From the main menu, click **Play** [1].
3. Select **Friend's Pass** [1].
4. Enter the Invite Code provided by the host into the input field [1]. Note that this code is strictly case-sensitive, so ensure all capital letters are entered correctly [1].
5. Click **Join** to enter the host's lobby [1].

### Starting the Session
Once the guest successfully joins the lobby, the host will see them appear in the game [1]. The host can then click the play button and select either **Start New Game** or **Load Game** to begin their cooperative RC car adventure [1].

## Version Matching and Troubleshooting

To ensure a stable connection and prevent progression issues, both players must run the exact same version of the game [1]. If your game versions do not match, you may experience connection failures or bugs during gameplay [1].

To verify your game version, look at the lower-left corner of the main menu [1]. Both players should check this number before attempting to connect [1]. If the numbers do not match, ensure that both players have downloaded the latest updates on Steam [1].

If you encounter login issues or cannot connect to the servers, try restarting Steam to force any pending updates to install [1]. If problems persist, the developers recommend ensuring that your antivirus or firewall is not blocking the game's network access.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Does my friend need to buy WheelMates to play with me?
No [1]. Only one player needs to own the full copy of WheelMates [1]. Your friend can download the free WheelMates Friend's Pass version to join your game at no additional cost [1].

### Can we play WheelMates via local co-op?
Yes [1]. WheelMates supports both online co-op using the Friend's Pass and local co-op on a single system [1].

### What should I do if the Invite Code is not working?
First, verify that the guest has entered the code exactly as it appears, as the Invite Code is case-sensitive [1]. Second, check the lower-left corner of the main menu on both computers to ensure both players are running the exact same version of the game [1].
